name: tpl-precedence-1-goal
task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key, then open the door and pick up the box.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the clauses capture the stated chain — blocker moved before key, key before door open, door open before box pickup — with hard Existence of the last step (target_picked_up), so all earlier steps are forced by the Precedence chain, and no clause adds an unspoken requirement.

texts: If blocker_moved occurs, then has_door_key occurs at some point, before or after it.
